intent.raw: Research academic foundations of novelty, creativity and learning; prepare successor strategies.
intent.objective: Prepare a bounded research route for a selected AC strategy, retaining source facts, critique openings, comparison lineage and learning evidence.
intent.target_artifact: Prospective study protocol and source-bound construction candidates; later comparative results only after actual execution.
intent.operator_sentence: Preserve the required function; vary a declared search process; construct and compare; test retention and transfer only when claimed.

scope_note: This is an unexecuted descriptive design. It is not a confirmation-ready or executable capability-bound dispatch, and creates no native role receipts.
preparation_requirements: Select cards and exact case sources.
Declare hard constraints, ordinary/component/upstream comparators and available controls.
Freeze condition prompts, selected Distill branch and actual budgets.
Prepare held-out cases and retained-state specification if testing learning.
Before delegated execution, prepare capability-bound role bindings, typed briefings, waves, write scopes and gates under the then-applicable runtime contract.

stop_conditions: Comparator or essential evidence unavailable: preserve unknown.
Attempt requires rewriting an earlier scored result.
Learning claim lacks declared retained state and unfamiliar-case evidence.

steps.name: Close the study and prepare evidence-bound method revisions

capability_metadata.validation_note: Bound explicitly to the installed skill; absent from this validator's small built-in capability list. Reflection emits proposals without canonical promotion.

stop_conditions: Any actual role remains open or unjoined.
No new evidence supports another round.

gates.condition: Before investigation: common frame, selected cards, fixed constraints, controls, comparators, budget and missing-data policy are declared.
Before comparison: selected branch preserves exact method, sources, rival predictions, resources, uncertainty and terminal no-opening results.
Before closeout: actual application, feasibility, local novelty, usefulness, burden and any learning outcome are separately assessed; missing results remain unknown.

Shape validation supports preparation only; original experiments retain their grades; academic rationale does not establish efficacy; canonical promotion requires its own lifecycle evidence and owner.

subagent_strategy.trigger: A future selected case exposes tensions between outcome obligations and construction/resource concerns.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Independent concern reports can expose conflicting assumptions before exchange; this document only prepares the strategy.
context: User requested research and strategy preparation, not a new scored native experiment in this extension.
Canonical Robot Talks applicability and runtime admission must be checked for the selected future case.

roles.purpose: Investigate the required function, evidence gaps, prior repertoire and candidate scope changes.
Investigate available mechanisms, controls, resource constraints and burden.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Before a future delegated experiment, present its exact selected cards, cases, role bindings, budget and write scopes for authorization, unless that execution is already authorized in the active session.

observability.signal_grouping: one source-bound research closeout per actual executed study; no execution signal is emitted by this preparation

promotion_guardrails: This route grants no canonical authority.
No implementation, adoption, persistent agent learning or field originality is inferred from route validation.
